name: @centraid/enrichment-service
description: Reference enrichment service (issue #724 W8): a standalone HTTP service that serves embed-image, embed-text, ocr, faces, and transcript capabilities over the frozen gateway wire contract. Pure TypeScript on Bun/Node — no Python anywhere. The one ML native dependency (onnxruntime-node) and its image-decode companion (sharp) live in the NON-workspace runtime/ directory (see runtime/package.json), installed and populated with model weights by `bun run setup`. This package's own dependency graph stays clean so a root `bun install` never pulls a native ML module.
